name: spectrabeam-optical-transfer
description: High-speed zero-network optical air-gap data transfer system using Luby Transform fountain codes, WebAssembly ZXing, and SpectraVault AES-256-GCM encryption.

scripts.test:turbo: node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('./src/core/test-turbo.ts').then(m => m.runTurboProtocolTests()).then(r => console.log('RESULT:', r.passed ? 'ALL TESTS PASSED' : 'FAILED')).catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test:turbo:e2e: node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('./src/core/test-turbo-e2e.ts').then(m => m.runTurboE2E()).then(r => console.log('RESULT:', r ? 'ALL TESTS PASSED' : 'FAILED')).catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); })"
